summary.result: Control of overplanting paddy rice and coordination of water distribution among water user associations would improve stable water level in the canal and, eventually, water delivery performance.
summary.background: Abstract In the North Nile Delta of Egypt, the impacts of overplanting paddy rice on water delivery performance have not been discussed quantitatively.
summary.method: The average adequacy for the investigation period was good at one location, fair at 2 locations, and poor at 3 locations in both years.
